request.style: English, worship, female solo voice with warm choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, cello, reverent and hopeful, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We have a great priest over God's house
Let us draw near with a true heart
Full assurance of faith guides us
Hearts sprinkled clean from evil conscience
Bodies washed with pure water

[Chorus]
Let us spur one another on
Toward love and good works
Not neglecting to meet together
But encouraging one another
All the more as the Day draws near

[Verse]
Hold unwavering to our hope
For He who promised is faithful
Do not let the habit grow
Of neglecting our gathering time
We need each other's strength

[Chorus]
Let us spur one another on
Toward love and good works
Not neglecting to meet together
But encouraging one another
All the more as the Day draws near

[Bridge]
The Day is drawing near to us
So we press on in faith
Encouraging one another daily
Walking in love and good works

[Chorus]
Let us spur one another on
Toward love and good works
Not neglecting to meet together
But encouraging one another
All the more as the Day draws near

[Outro]
Encouraging one another
As the Day draws near
